definitions.gloss: nighttime, at night, during the night
definitions.explanation: Refers to the period of time between evening and morning when it is dark.

examples.japanese: {夜間|やかん}の{運転|うんてん}は{危険|きけん}だ。
この{道路|どうろ}は{夜間|やかん}{通行止|つうこうど}めになる。
examples.english: This road is closed at night.

examples.japanese: {夜間|やかん}{学校|がっこう}に{通|かよ}っている。
{夜間|やかん}{勤務|きんむ}は{体|からだ}に{負担|ふたん}がかかる。
examples.english: Working the night shift is hard on the body.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}は{夜間|やかん}に{行|おこな}われるので、{昼間|ひるま}は{通|とお}れます。
examples.english: Construction takes place at night, so you can pass through during the day.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{夜間|やかん}{営業|えいぎょう} (night business/operating at night)
・{夜間|やかん}{勤務|きんむ} (night shift)
・{夜間|やかん}{学校|がっこう} (night school)
・{夜間|やかん}{飛行|ひこう} (night flight)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{夜|よる} - night (general, everyday term)
・{深夜|しんや} - late night, midnight
・{夜中|よなか} - middle of the night
